description: The first CLI for Afi SaaS backup — full public-API coverage plus the fleet-wide coverage, staleness, and offboarding answers the rate-limited API can't serve live.

novel_features.name: Fleet sync
novel_features.description: Walk the whole Afi hierarchy — installations, orgs, tenants, then each tenant's resources, protections, policies, archives, quotas, and task stats — into local SQLite in one respectful pass.

novel_features.name: Unprotected-resources gap finder
novel_features.description: Find resources in a tenant that have no backup protection applied — the backup blind spots.

novel_features.name: Fleet health digest
novel_features.description: One table across all synced tenants: task success/failure counts, failed-task list, and quota breaches.

novel_features.name: Archive-and-offboard helper
novel_features.description: Safely back up a departing user's resource, verify the archive landed, then release the protection — refusing the irreversible step until the backup is confirmed.

novel_features.name: External-ID resolver
novel_features.description: Map a Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace ID, email, or name to the canonical Afi resource or tenant, including Multi-Geo fan-out.

novel_features.name: License reconciliation
novel_features.description: Compare purchased subscription quantities against actually-protected resource counts per tenant to flag over- and under-provisioning.

novel_features.name: Backup staleness watch
novel_features.description: Flag protected resources that are not getting backed up (no archive at all, or no backup task finished in their tenant in the synced window) — protected-but-silently-failing resources.

novel_features.name: Tenant backup scorecard
novel_features.description: One tenant's full backup posture: coverage percentage, last task status, newest/oldest archive age, and quota state.
